cards.title: Absence of Evidence Fallacy
cards.front: Absence of Evidence Fallacy — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: "No evidence of", "we have not seen", "there is no indication".
cards.move: Pair every negative finding with the collection behind it.

cards.title: Anchoring Bias
cards.front: Anchoring Bias — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: A number or a phrase that first appeared in an earlier product, unchanged.
cards.move: Re-derive the figure before reusing it, or say that you have not.

cards.title: Availability Heuristic
cards.front: Availability Heuristic — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: The most recent incident shaping a forward-looking judgement.
cards.move: Add the historical baseline next to the recent case.

cards.title: Base-Rate Neglect
cards.front: Base-Rate Neglect — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: An indicator, alert or typology with no benign explanation rate.
cards.move: State the benign rate alongside the malicious one, even approximately.

cards.title: Belief Perseverance
cards.front: Belief Perseverance — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: A judgement carried into a re-issue without its original uncertainty.
cards.move: Restate the uncertainty at re-issue, not just at first assessment.

cards.title: Confirmation Bias
cards.front: Confirmation Bias — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: A hypothesis and a pile of support, with no rival hypothesis anywhere on the page.
cards.move: Write the strongest competing hypothesis beside the leading one, and mark which evidence discriminates.

cards.title: Conformity Bias
cards.front: Conformity Bias — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: A review comment that changed nothing and was not recorded.
cards.move: Record the reasoning before the discussion, and record the query after it.

cards.title: Escalation of Commitment
cards.front: Escalation of Commitment — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: A line or a capability defended by its history rather than its yield.
cards.move: Ask: if it did not exist today, would we build it?

cards.title: Framing Effect
cards.front: Framing Effect — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: The tasking's own words, unexamined, at the top of your draft.
cards.move: Rewrite the tasking in your own words, and say what the other framing would have produced.

cards.title: Fundamental Attribution Error
cards.front: Fundamental Attribution Error — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: "Aggressive", "opportunistic", "deceptive by nature".
cards.move: State the situational driver that would produce the same behaviour.

cards.title: Groupthink
cards.front: Groupthink — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: A judgement nobody has argued against, in a team that agrees.
cards.move: Independent judgements in writing, then reconcile; name a challenger.

cards.title: Hindsight Bias
cards.front: Hindsight Bias — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: A post-mortem conclusion that the outcome was foreseeable.
cards.move: Check it against the judgement that was actually written at the time.

cards.title: Insensitivity to Sample Size
cards.front: Insensitivity to Sample Size — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: "Campaign", "pattern", "characteristic" with no count in the sentence.
cards.move: Put the count (n) in the sentence and let the reader see it.

cards.title: Loss Aversion
cards.front: Loss Aversion — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: "The consequences of missing this are unacceptable."
cards.move: State what it costs to be wrong in each direction.

cards.title: Mirror Imaging
cards.front: Mirror Imaging — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: "They would not do X because it makes no sense."
cards.move: One line naming what the actor would have to believe for the behaviour to make sense to them.

cards.title: Overconfidence Bias
cards.front: Overconfidence Bias — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: "Will", "clearly", "obviously", "always", or an unqualified number.
cards.move: Re-earn or strike each absolute on the final read.

cards.title: Recency Bias
cards.front: Recency Bias — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: A trend drawn from the current period alone.
cards.move: Show the current period against the prior baseline.

cards.title: Representativeness Heuristic
cards.front: Representativeness Heuristic — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: "Matches the profile", "consistent with the established pattern".
cards.move: Ask how many other actors would look identical, and name the evidence that would separate them.

cards.title: Selective Perception
cards.front: Selective Perception — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: Nothing — an absence. The item you cannot find because it was never registered.
cards.move: Read the file, not the draft, and name one item that argues against the judgement.

cards.title: Status Quo Bias
cards.front: Status Quo Bias — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: "Unchanged", "no change to the previous assessment".
cards.move: Date the review and say when the evidence was last tested.

cards.title: Vividness Bias
cards.front: Vividness Bias — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: A single striking item — a figure, an image, a quote — near the top.
cards.move: State the source's status against that item, in the product.

cards.title: Carried-Forward Assessment
cards.front: Carried-Forward Assessment — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: "No change" accepted by the process, with no scheduled review and nobody able to say who last tested the evidence.
cards.move: Put the review on a calendar with a named owner, and print the date the evidence was last tested.

cards.title: Inherited Partner Reporting
cards.front: Inherited Partner Reporting — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: Reporting you did not collect, cannot re-derive, and have never seen the handling caveats behind.
cards.move: State the partner's caveats in your own product in your own words — or state that you do not have them.

cards.title: Single-Source Dependency
cards.front: Single-Source Dependency — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: The key judgement rests on one report, one chain, and a source you cannot see to the end.
cards.move: Name the dependency in the product, and say what the judgement would look like if that source were wrong.

cards.title: Thin Analytic Coverage
cards.front: Thin Analytic Coverage — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: One name on a national question, and no second reading of the same file.
cards.move: Say in the product how many analysts the judgement rests on, and what a second reader would have been asked to check.

cards.title: Volume Mistaken for Development
cards.front: Volume Mistaken for Development — what is the tell, and what is the one move?
cards.signature: The reporting curve is rising and the product reads it as the activity curve.
cards.move: Separate the reporting curve from the activity curve, and say which one the trend rests on.
